The Horizon
AI threat intelligence dashboard — prototype access

Dear colleagues,

AI is not only changing the way we work, it also brings new threats and risks. To make these developments easier to understand, we invite you to explore The Horizon, our AI × Threat Intelligence dashboard:

Explore the dashboard →

You do not need to be an AI specialist to use it. The dashboard is designed to help anyone quickly explore the evolving intersection of AI and cyber threats, discover emerging issues, and better understand why they may matter.

Whether you work in development, operations, or corporate functions, The Horizon offers a simple starting point for staying informed and asking the right questions.

Take a few minutes to explore the dashboard and make sense of what is appearing on the horizon. Your feedback will also help us make it more useful, accessible, and relevant to a wider range of users.

We hope you find it insightful — and perhaps discover something you were not expecting.

Best regards,

CSEC AI Team

What it does
Core Functions

Here is a closer look at what The Horizon offers, and how each part might prove useful in your day-to-day work.

01
Threat Dashboard

Track how AI threats develop by week, month, and quarter across four categories, each with trend signals and cited sources you can open.
02
Ask Agent

Ask a question in plain language and get a cited answer in seconds, ideal for quick research, briefing prep, or tracking a threat over time.
03
Briefing Decks

Preparing to update leadership or a wider team? The dashboard builds a PowerPoint with summaries, findings, and trend analysis.

Request access

To request an account, email [name] at [email]. We will send your login details and a short user guide once you are registered. Please use your CSA email address for anything account-related.

This is an early prototype. We welcome your feedback, and it will help shape what we build next.

Note: As The Horizon is currently hosted on Vercel, it is not accessible on COMET laptops and will need to be opened on a personal device. We recognise this is not ideal and plan to migrate to a more suitable cloud hosting environment, such as AWS, in a future version to enable access on government-issued devices.

Internal use only. The Horizon is a CSA prototype and is not accessible to the public or external organisations.
